thread:
Kevin (AE): Need quick approval for a one-off pricing override for SeniorCare AI. They're onboarding 3 dedicated units but asked for a 35% setup credit and extended Net45 for first 2 invoices. Quote ID: Q-2026-5889.
Maria G: Context — customer signed PO but finance hit the SLA change request. They agreed to 12-month term, standard committed pricing otherwise. Sales wants the onboarding credit to reduce churn risk.
Brynn (Finance): Numbers? show ARR and margin impact. We need to confirm there's an internal exception for Net45 vs our Net30 policy.
Kevin (AE): ARR on the committed seats is $240k ARR. Setup one-time charges are $30k pre-discount. With 35% setup credit that's $10.5k credit. Gross margin still >40% post-credit per my calc.
Dave (CSM): They asked for extra onboarding support (SLA 99.9 for first 90 days) — that's why they're requesting credit. We can provide onboarding engineers but want visibility on cost.
Brynn (Finance): Ok that helps. For Net45 we need AR signoff. Can we make the credit conditional on: 1) signed PO 2) invoice auto-pay after second invoice?
Kevin (AE): They prefer vendor banking terms but agreed to auto-pay after the trial period. I'll add that to PO terms.
Sophie (Legal): I scanned the PO. No unusual indemnities. Legal is fine with conditional credit clause. Need wording: "35% one-time setup credit applied to invoice #1; credit void if payment terms are not met for invoice #1 and #2." Approve?
Brynn (Finance): If that wording is baked in and we get AR approve for Net45 exception, I'm +1. Please provide the final quote with T&Cs and we'll stamp.
BillingBot: New invoice draft generated: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/drafts/INV-2026-7682 (preview only).
Kevin (AE): Pasting the final billing snippet I'll send to customer: 
```
Quote: Q-2026-5889
Term: 12 months
Seats: 3 dedicated units
One-time setup: $30,000 -> 35% credit ($10,500)
Recurring: $20,000/mo
Payment terms: Net45 for first two invoices, auto-pay thereafter
Condition: Credit applies only if invoice #1 and #2 are paid per terms
```
Dave (CSM): :thumbsup: I'll notify onboarding to reserve two engineers for week 1-2.
Brynn (Finance): Routing to AR for Net45 exception now. Tagging @Maria G for any outstanding docs.
Maria G: Uploaded signed PO to the shared drive and updated the quote with the conditional clause. Link: https://redwood.shared/seniorcare/po.pdf
Brynn (Finance): AR approved Net45 exception for this one-off (ref AR-EX-2026-44). Final approval from finance to apply 35% one-time credit. Logging in system.
Kevin (AE): Amazing — sending to customer now. Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
Sophie (Legal): Noted; legal retains a copy of PO and conditional clause.
BillingBot: Credit applied to draft invoice INV-2026-7682. Status: pending final send.
Dave (CSM): Closing loop with customer in 30min after I confirm payment setup.
Kevin (AE): Closing thread — will follow up if they push for larger discount
